gameDescriptionHtml:
Strange Magic is turning the world upside down in Equestria and it is up to you to take the power of friendship to new heights and embark on a mystery adventure for one or two ponies.

With everypony working together, you can uncover the unstable magic that’s turning phones into pizza, breaking gravity, and splashing colors everywhere.

Play as Sunny, Hitch, Izzy, Pipp, Zipp, and Misty and use your special abilities to explore Zephyr Heights. It’s a gleaming city in the sky full of pegasi to meet, special collectibles to find, and photo opportunities with your favorite ponies.

You’ll also have a ton of fun with your pony besties, with hilarious minigames like Pipp’s Photo Shoot, Hitch is on the trail, and Sunny’s Smoothie Delivery, plus a closet full of accessories to show off your own personal style.

With minigames, collectibles, photos, and more!

It’s time to bring order back to Zephyr Heights!

Game Features

  • EVERYPONY IS HERE – Play with your favorite ponies.
  • EXPLORE THE KINGDOM – Save the cloud city of Zephyr Heights.
  • PLAY CO-OP – Adventure with one or two players.
  • LOOK YOUR BEST – Style your pony friends with custom accessories.
  • FIND FUN EVERYWHERE – With minigames, collectibles, photos, and more!
